body: Laura Kazimer established Divine Emergence, LLC after years of hands-on experience. She has trained dozens of facilitators as a Master Trainer with Awakened Breath, conducted hundreds of private sessions, and led sold-out workshops and international retreats.

The training emphasizes trauma-informed breathwork supported by modern science. Intentional breathing has been shown to help process stress and emotion, trauma, anxiety, depression, addictive patterns, OCD, and so much more. It is for corporate professionals seeking meaningful careers, empaths called to service, therapists, yoga instructors, coaches, and anyone drawn to teach breathwork transformation.

title: Breathwork Training Program

steps.label: Week 1
steps.title: Introduction to Breathwork
steps.text: Explore the history, evolution, and different realms of breathwork, from ancient Pranayama to functional and modern dynamic practices. Learn foundational breathing mechanics, calming  techniques, and how to guide breathwork for nervous system regulation.

steps.label: Week 2
steps.title: The Nervous System & Functional Breathing
steps.text: Dive into the autonomic nervous system, breathing physiology, and the relationship between breath, stress, and regulation. Learn functional breathing principles and how to assess and guide the breath for greater regulation, resilience, and overall health and wellness.

steps.label: Week 3
steps.title: Altered States Breathwork
steps.text: Explore conscious circular breathing, and the use of the breath to access altered states of consciousness. Understand what happens physiologically during these experiences, how to prepare for a journey, and experience circular breathwork firsthand.

steps.label: Week 4
steps.title: Trauma Awareness, Safety & Contraindications
steps.text: Understand how past experiences can influence the nervous system, behavior, and a person’s response during breathwork. Learn to recognize potential trauma responses while prioritizing safety, consent, autonomy, appropriate pacing, contraindications, and scope of practice.

steps.label: Week 5
steps.title: The Art of Facilitation
steps.text: Learn the art of holding space and intentionally curating a breathwork experience from beginning to end. Develop the presence, awareness, and confidence to guide others while using music, verbal guidance, energy, environment, and intentional pacing to create a powerful and supportive experience.

steps.label: Week 6
steps.title: Building & Growing Your Practice
steps.text: Turn your skills into a professional breathwork practice. Explore business structure, branding, positioning, pricing, marketing, client attraction, and the foundations needed to begin building a sustainable practice around your work.

steps.label: Week 7
steps.title: Creating & Launching Your Offerings
steps.text: Learn how to turn your knowledge into experiences people can actually participate in. Design workshops, group breathwork experiences, and 1:1 sessions while learning how to use tools such as Canva, Eventbrite, AI, booking systems, and CRM platforms to organize, market, and launch your offerings.

steps.label: Week 8
steps.title: Integration, Practicum & Certification
steps.text: Bring everything together through practical application. Demonstrate your understanding of breathwork, safety, facilitation, and session design through your final assessment and practicum. Complete the training by preparing to launch your own offering and celebrating your certification as a breathwork practitioner.
